scoring_justification: The main load-bearing step recomputes the activation boundary and power-law fit from the raw CSV, and the regimes are checked structurally. The companion JSON step uses reference_match for the agent‑reported fit parameters. The recomputed quantities are compared to the paper’s reported exponent -2 and prefactor 35.93 with appropriate tolerances.

hidden_assets.purpose: gold values for power-law scaling (exponent -2, prefactor 35.93) and regime verification
hidden_assets.source_provenance: paper Fig.7 and text: a0,min/lG = 35.93 (β Cr)^(-2) for R/l_G=4.2×10^4, regime I and III thresholds
hidden_assets.generation_method: extracted from paper text and consistent with reference solve.sh synthetic data
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: values directly reported in the paper (prefactor A=35.93, exponent -2) and the regime boundaries (a0/lG > 10^4 and < 500) are described in the text; no invention needed.

outputs.description: Raw activation map for a 2D circular particle with R/l_G=4.2e4. The checker recomputes the activation threshold boundary, fits the power-law, and verifies the three fracture regimes from this CSV.

A.description: Prefactor in power-law a0_min/lG = A (β Cr)^p

fitting_range_min_a0_over_lG.description: Minimum a0/lG used in the fit

fitting_range_max_a0_over_lG.description: Maximum a0/lG used in the fit

observed_R3_constant_a0min.description: If regime III observed, the constant minimum flaw size a0_min/lG; otherwise null.

outputs.description: Agent-reported power-law fit parameters. The checker compares A and exponent to paper-reported gold values within defined tolerances.

output_contract.notes: The checker recomputes the activation boundary from the raw CSV, fits the power-law, and verifies that for a0/lG > 10^4 no activation occurs for Cr < 10 (Regime I) and for a0/lG < 500 no activation occurs for any simulated Cr (Regime III). The power_law_fit.json is cross-checked for consistency with the CSV-derived fit.

config.description: Recompute activation boundary, fit power-law, verify regimes I and III
